scorecard.title: College Scorecard API record (IPEDS unit id 182670, locale 33 town)

stats.notes: The Common Data Set's residency table gives applicants by in-state/out-of-state/international only (no admits by residency); 154 international students enrolled. Waitlist: 2,497 were offered a place; Dartmouth did not report the accepted and admitted counts. Dartmouth did not report GPA; class rank: 96% in the top tenth. Student-to-faculty ratio 7.9 to 1, rounded to 8.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set (applying for Fall 2027): SAT or ACT required to be considered for admission.

cost.notes: First-year costs from the Common Data Set: tuition $69,207, required fees $2,318, food and housing $20,920; books $1,005, transportation $608 + other $2,040 (shown together as other costs, 608 + 2,040). The Common Data Set's tuition and fees checkbox says 2026-27 costs are 'not available' yet values are filled in, so the year label follows the Common Data Set prompt. Need-based institutional aid is available to nonresidents; 483 awarded, average $87,562, total $42,292,307
